fixed.explanation: runDaemonForContext binds the browser to a new session name every time it runs. A second context on the same browser, such as one from a worker-scoped fixture, triggers a second bind on an already-bound browser, which crashes. I added a WeakSet so each browser is bound and announced only once. Later contexts on that browser skip the bind and the printout. I haven't seen the caller, so I can't confirm this is the exact crash site.
